biggest_catch: Both sides earn 2,000 points (~$2) but you cannot redeem until you bank 3,000 points ($3 minimum) - one referral alone does not reach a cash-out; the referral bonus amount is also subject to change and is confirmed in-app at signup.
catches: 2,000 points each side (~$2); points are not cash until redeemed for a gift card.
Redemption minimum is 3,000 points ($3) - a single referral's 2,000 points must be combined with other points (receipts, more referrals).
The friend must enter your code during signup or before snapping their first receipt - the code-entry option disappears after the first successful receipt.
Receipts must be recent, readable, and eligible (Fetch's standard receipt rules).
US only - the app does not work outside the United States.
Referral bonus amount can change; the Fetch app confirms the current amount at signup.

steps: Open Fetch Rewards and get your unique referral code (Me tab > Refer a friend).
Share the code/link with a friend who is new to Fetch.
Friend signs up with your code and enters it during signup or before snapping their first receipt.
Friend snaps their first eligible receipt.
2,000 points are added automatically to both accounts once the first receipt is processed; redeem gift cards (incl. Visa) once you bank 3,000 points.
